spans.s: A man, male person; संयोजयति विद्यैव नीचगापि नरं सरित् । समुद्रमिव दुर्धर्षं नृपं भाग्यमतः परम् ॥ H.
A man or piece at chess.
The Supreme Spirit, the original or eternal man.
N. of Arjuna; see नरनारायण below.
eruption on the face. -अधमः a wretch, miscreant.-अधिपः, अधिपतिः, -ईशः, -ईश्वरः, -देवः, -पतिः, -पालः a king; नरपतिहितकर्ता द्वेष्यतां याति लोके Pt. नराणां च नराधिपम्
. -अन्तकः death. -अयनः an epithet of Viṣṇu. नराणामयनं यस्मात् तेन नारायणः स्मृतः Brav.P. -अशः a demon, goblin. -आधारः N. of Śiva. (-रा) the earth.
इतरः a being higher than a man, a god;
a physician, dealer in antidotes, curer of poisons; तेषु कश्चि- न्नरेन्द्राभिमानी तां निर्वर्ण्य
; सुनिग्रहा नरेन्द्रेण फणीन्द्रा इव शत्रवः Śi.2.88. (where the word is used in both senses). ˚मार्गः a high street, main road.
of Buddha. -ऋषभः 'the chief of men', a prince, king. -कपालः a man's skull. -कीलकः the murderer of a spiritual preceptor.-केश(स)रिन् m.
Viṣṇu in his fourth incarnation; cf. नरसिंह below.
the chief of men. -चिह्नम् the moustaches.
देवः the warrior class (क्षत्रिय); शिष्ट्वा वा भूमि- देवानां नरदेवसमागमे
a king. -धिः the world.-द्विष् m. a demon, goblin; तेन मूर्धानमध्वंसन्नरद्विषः

. -नारायणः N. of Kṛiṣṇa. (-णौ dual) originally regarded as identical, but in mythology and epic poetry, considered as distinct beings, Arjuna being identified with Nara and Kṛiṣṇa with Nārāyaṇa. [In some places they are called देवौ, पूर्वदेवौ, ऋषी or ऋषिसत्तमौ. They are said to have been practising very austere penance on the Himālaya, which excited the fear of Indra, and he sent down several damsels to disturb their austerities. But Nārāyaṇa put all of them to shame by creating a nymph called Urvaśī from a flower placed on his thigh who excelled them in beauty; cf. स्थाने खलु नारायणमृषिं विलोभयन्त्यस्तदूरुसंभवामिमां दृष्ट्वा व्रीडिताः सर्वा अप्सरस इति
.] -पशुः 'a beast-like man', a beast in human form. -पुङ्गवः 'best of men', an excellent man; शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः

. -बलिः a human sacrifice. -भुज्a. man-eating, cannibal. -भूः f. the Bharatavarṣa,i. e. India. -मानिका, मानिनी, -मालिनी 'manlike woman', a woman with a beard, masculine woman or an amazon. -माला a girdle of skulls. -मेधः a human sacrifice. -यन्त्रम् sun-dial. -यानम्, -रथः, -वाहनम् a vehicle drawn by men, a palanquin; नरयानादवातीर्य Par- ṇāl.4.17;
लोकः 'the world of men', the earth, terrestrial world.
mankind. -वाहनः an epithet of Kubera; विजयदुन्दुभितां ययुरर्णवा घनरवा नर- वाहनसंपदः

. -विष्वणः a demon, goblin. -वीरः a brave man, hero. -व्याघ्रः, -शार्दूलः an eminent man.-शृङ्गम् 'man's horn', an impossibility, a chimera, non-entity. -संसर्गः human society. -सखः an epithet of Nārayaṇa; ऊरूद्भवा नरसखस्य मुनेः सुरस्त्री
. -सिंहः, -हरिः 'man-lion', Viṣṇu in his fourth incarnation; cf. तव करकमलवरे नखमद्भुतशृङ्गं दलितहिरण्यकशिपुतनुभृङ्गम् । केशव धृत- नरहरिरूप जय जगदीश हरे ॥
. -सिंहद्वादशी the 12th day in the light half of फाल्गुन. -स्कन्धः a multitude or body of men. -हयम् a fight or enmity between man and horse.

नरकः [narakḥ] कम् [kam], कम् 1 Hell, infernal regions (corresponding to the realm of Pluto; there are said to be 21 different parts of these regions where different kinds of tortures are inflicted upon sinners तामिस्र, अन्धतामिस्र, महारौरव, रौरव, नरक, कालसूत्र, महानरक, संजीवन, माहवीचि, तपन, संप्रतापन, संहात, काकोल, कुड्मल, प्रतिमूर्तिक, लोहशङ्कु, ऋजीष, पन्था, शाल्मली, असितपत्रवन, लोहदारक are the 21 Narakas; cf.

A liquor-vessel; नरकं मद्यभाजने Nm. -कः N. of a demon, king of Prāgjyotiṣa. [According to one account he carried off Aditi's ear-rings and Kṛiṣna at the request of the gods killed him in a single combat and recovered the jewels. According to another account, Naraka assumed the form of an elephant and carried off the daughter of Viśvakarman and outraged her. He also seized the daughters of Gandharvas, gods, men and the nymphs themselves, and collected more than 16 damsels in his harem. These, it is related, were transferred by Kṛiṣṇa to his own harem after he had slain Naraka. The demon was born of earth, and hence called 'Bhauma'] -Comp. -अन्तकः, -अरिः, -जित्, -रिपुः m. epithets of Kṛiṣṇa; नरकरिपुणा सार्धं तेषां सभीमकिरीटिनाम्

a ghost, spirit. -आवासः an inhabitant of hell. -कुण्डम् a pit in hell where the wicked are tormented (86 such places are enumerated). -देवता 'the deity of hell', Nirṛiti (निर्ऋति). -रूपिन् a. hellish.-वासः the abode in hell. -स्या the Vaitariṇī river.
नरकायते [narakāyatē], Den. Ā. To resemble a hell.
नराचः [narācḥ], N. of a metre of sixteen syllables; भुजङ्गराज- भाषितं प्रकीर्णशास्त्रसागरे लघौ गुरौ निरन्तरे सतीह षोडशाक्षरे । प्रताप- तापनिर्जितप्रभाकरप्रकाशहे प्रवृत्तवृत्तराजकं नराचमेव मन्महे ॥
नाराचः [nārācḥ], [नरान् आचामति आ-चम्-ड स्वार्थे अण् , नारम् आचामति वा Tv.]
An arrow in general; सर्वलोहास्तु ये बाणाः नाराचास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः । पञ्चभिः पृथुलैः पक्षैर्युक्ताः सिध्यन्ति कस्यचित् ॥
A road running towards the east; Kāmikāgama 25.3.
नरी [narī], A woman; नम्या नरीभिरमरीव हि सा विरेजे
A woman; अर्थतः पुरुषो नारी या नारी सार्थतः पुमान्
a libertine. -दूषणम् a woman's vice: (they are: पानं दुर्जनसंसर्गः पत्या च विरहो$टनम् । स्वप्नो$न्यगृहवासश्च नारीणां दूषणानि षट्
). -नाथ a. having a woman for possessor or owner; क्वचिदपि गृहं नारीनाथं निरीक्ष्य विवर्जितम्
.-परायण a. devoted to women. -पुरम् women's apartment in house, gynaeceum. -प्रसंगः lechery, libertinism.-रत्नम् a jewel of a woman, an excellent woman.
नर्त [narta], a. [नृत्-अच्] Dancing. -र्तः Dancing, a dance.
A dancer; sometimes a dancing preceptor.
An actor, mime, mummer; नाराजके जनपदे प्रहृष्टनटनर्तकः
N. of a mixed tribe (वेश्यायां रजकाज्जातो नर्तको गायको भवेत्).
की A female dancer, a singing girl, an actress; रङ्गस्य दर्शयित्वा निवर्तते नर्तकी यथा नृत्यात् Sāṅ.
63.4. -नम् Gesticulation, dancing, dance. -Comp. -गृहम्, -शाला a dancing hall.
नर्तयितृ [nartayitṛ], m. A dancing-master; अद्य नर्तयितास्मि
नर्तु [nartu], a. Dancing on the edge of a sword. f. A female dancer or actress.
नर्दटकः [nardaṭakḥ], N. of a metre of seventy syllables.
Celebrated. -तः A kind of die or a throw at dice; नर्दितदर्शितमार्गः कटेन विनिपातितो यामि
To bellow, roar, sound in general; अनर्दिषुः कपिव्याघ्राः
नर्द्धिः [narddhiḥ], (न+ऋद्धिः) Adversity; ऋद्धिर्वा$प्यथवा नर्द्धिः पर्याय - कृतमेव तत्
Sport, amusement, diversion, merriment, pleasure, amorous pastime or sport; जित- कमले विमले परिकर्मय नर्मजनकमलकं मुखे
Jest, joke, humour, wit; सुहृत्प्रयुक्ता इव नर्मवादाः
; 'jocular, humorous'. -Comp. -आलापः a jocular conversation.-उक्तिः a facetious expression. -कीलः a husband. -गर्भa. humorous, full of humour, witty.
an action of the hero in an unrecognizable form. -द a. delighting, making happy; नन्दसूनुरनघे तव वत्सो नर्मदः प्रणयिनां विजहार

. (-दः) a jester (= नर्मसचिव q. v.). -दा N. of a river which rises in the Vindhya mountain, and falls into the gulf of Cambay. -द्युति a. bright with joy, cheerful, merry. (-तिः f.) enjoyment of a joke. -सचिवः, -सुहृद् m. 'a pleasure-companion', an associate of the amusements of a prince or a man of rank; न नर्मसचिवैः सार्धं किञ्चिदप्य- प्रियं वदेत् Kām. इदं त्वैदंपर्यं यदुत नृपतेर्नर्मसचिवः सुतादाना- न्मित्रं भवतु
superintendence of a prince's amusements. -स्फूर्जः (in drama) the first meeting of lovers beginning with joy but ending alarm. -स्फोटः the first symptoms of love.
नर्मवत् [narmavat], a. Humorous, witty. -n. A kind of drama.
Indra. -र्यौ (du.) The two objects of human desire, i. e. Heaven and earth.
रम् A multitude or assemblage of men.
Dry ginger.-Comp. -कीटः a deceiver (disappointing expectations raised by himself). -जीवनम् gold.
नारक [nāraka], a. (-की f.) [नरक एव प्रज्ञा˚ अण् नरकस्येदम् अण् वा] Hellish, relating to hell, infernal.
कः The infernal regions, hell; कुभ्मीपाकं गुरुमपि हरे नारकं नापनेतुम् Mukundamālā 6.
नारकिक [nārakika] नारकिन् [nārakin] नारकीय [nārakīya], नारकिन् नारकीय a. Hellish. -m. An inhabitant of hell.
ङ्गम्, ङ्गकम् The fruit of the orange tree; सद्योमुण्डितमत्तहूणचिबुकप्रस्पर्धि नारङ्गकम्.
The juice of the pepper plant.

नारदः [nāradḥ], [नरस्य धर्मो नारं, तत् ददाति दा-क] N. of a celebrated Devarṣi (deified saint or divine sage). [He is one of the ten mind-born sons of Brahmā, being supposed to have sprung from his thigh (

). He is represented as a messenger from the gods to men and vice versa and as being very fond of promoting discords among gods and men; hence his epithet of Kalipriya. He is said to have been the inventor of the lute or Vīṇā. He is also the author of a code of laws which goes by his name.] -Comp. -उपनिषद् N. of a Upaniṣad.
नारसिंह [nārasiṃha], a. (-ही f.) Pertaining to Narasimha.
The 16th period of the world (कल्प). -Comp. -चूर्णम् N. of a particular aphrodisiac.
नाराचिका [nārācikā] नाराची [nārācī], नाराची A goldsmith's scales (assay balance).
नारायणः [nārāyaṇḥ], 1 An epithet of Viṣṇu; (the word is thus derived in
आपो वै नरसूनवः । ता यदस्यायनं पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः ॥) नारायणं नमस्कृत्य ...... ततो जयमुदीरयेत्
; नीरे नीरचरैः समं स भगवान् निद्राति नारायणः Jagannātha Paṇḍita.
N. of an ancient sage said to be a companion of Nara and to have produced Urvaśī from his thigh; cf. ऊरूद्भवा नरसखस्य मुनेः सुरस्त्री
N. of the second month (reckoning from मार्गशीर्ष).
णी An epithet of Lakṣmī the goddess of wealth.
An epithet of Gaṅgā and Gaṇḍakī.
N. of a plant (Mar. शतावरी). -Comp. -अस्त्रम् N. of a missile. -उपनिषद् N. of an Upaniṣad.
yellow sandal-wood. -बलिः an oblation given to five deities including नारायण in performing the funeral rites of a person dying a sinful death.
नारिकेरः [nārikērḥ] लः [lḥ], लः The cocoa-nut; नारिकेलसमाकार दृश्यन्ते हि सुहृज्जनाः
. [The word is also written नारिकेलि-ली, नारिकेर-ल, नारीकेलि-ली, नाडि(डी)केर, नालिकेर (
), नालिकेलि-ली.] -ली Fermented liquor made from the water of the cocoa-nut.
नारीकम् [nārīkam], (in Sāṅkhya) One of the 9 kinds of तुष्टि.
नार्पत्य [nārpatya], a. Kingly, relating to royalty.
नार्पयति [nārpayati], [न + अर्पयति] To surrender to the king (i. e. property);
